name: marketing-logo-clouds
title: Logo Clouds
description: Explore a curated collection of logo cloud components built with Tailwind CSS. Display client, partner, and brand logos with modern, responsive layouts perfect for marketing websites.
useWhen: Explore a curated collection of logo cloud components built with Tailwind CSS. Display client, partner, and brand logos with modern, responsive layouts perfect for marketing websites.
avoidWhen: Avoid logo clouds when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Logo Clouds uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
